messages:
elaine-sales: POC with NovaPay hitting dims mismatch + intermittent 429s on embedding bulk ingest. Help?

pavan-ml: what model are they sending and what's the error text?

elaine-sales: from their logs:
```
ERROR: embed mismatch: expected 1024 got 1536
POST /v1/embeddings -> 200 (model=embed-adv-1536)
/compare -> 400 {\"error\":\"dimension mismatch\"}
```

liam-eng: sounds like index was built with 1024-d vectors; client now returns 1536. Two quick fixes: re-index with 1536 OR pin the SDK to an older model to match index for the POC.

sara-se: also seeing 429s: quota-bot shows X-RateLimit-Remaining:0 on bulk endpoint. Likely their batch_size/concurrency too high.

elaine-sales: customer insists they "didn't change code" but they deploy via CI so a dependency bump could have switched default model.

pavan-ml: mitigation steps for customer: 1) run single-item curl to verify .model and embedding length, 2) set client param model:'embed-base-1024' if they want immediate unblock, 3) reduce batch_size to 8-16 and add exponential backoff for 429s.

liam-eng: infra can run a one-off reindex if they choose that path; will queue job on request.

quota-bot: POC uplift available for 48h. To request, provide customer name + target QPS.

elaine-sales: I asked them to pin model + throttle ingestion. They confirmed pin fixed dim mismatch and 429s reduced. They'll schedule re-index after POC. Thanks all :thumbsup:
